content: Pita Yakshii Mǝ mBii Ɗe Nǝ Cìn
Jeplep mo kǝ nenseet nɗang Jesu ɗe mon nJudiya, mo kǝlǝng nǝ, pak gurum ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas, mo kǝ lappwoo Naan zak.
Kaaɗe Pita kàa wul nJerusalem, ɓǝ nen shinzeen ɗe mo kǝ can mo, mo yool kǝ pwoo nkaa wur.
Mo sat nǝnee, <<Waa dǝm a ɗel nlu mǝ nen ɗe nsuluk mo har a se mbiise ashak kǝ mo.>>
Aasǝ ɓǝ Pita yaa yakshii mǝ mbii ɗe nǝ cìn jir, wur sat mmo nǝnee,
<<Dǝ an nɗǝǝn pee nkaam nJoppa, ɓǝ kaaɗe an nkaa ɗangnaan ɓǝ wen suun. Ɓǝ nɗǝǝn suun nǝ, nnaa mee haal ɗeɗes ɗe nǝ tong aɗeng sham ɗe, nǝ kǝ kwang mo feer, nǝ sham wul pǝ an ɗi.
Wen ban yit nkaa nǝ, ɓǝ nnaa longlu mo, kǝ luwaayil mo, kǝ mbii ɗe mo kǝ fee shi ɓut mo, kǝ nyer ɗe mo kǝ yool ncáap, mo ɗi nɗǝǝn nǝ.
Ɓǝ nkǝlǝng mee ɗoo, ɗe nǝ sat nghan nǝnee, <Pita, a yool a saa mo, a se.>
Ɗangɓe wen nsat nǝnee, <Hai Daa! Baa wen kǝn cam se mee luwaa ɗebuu, koo ɗe baa nǝ ret kǝ ngu Yahudi se kas.>
Yaksǝ ɗoo nǝ cin sat ɗi nghan aɗeng nǝnee, <Mbii ɗe Naan le a ɗeɓang, ɓǝ taji a le nǝ a ɗebish kas.>
Mo cìn a kǝsǝ, dǝm wul ar kun, ɓǝ mo waa baa dul haal nǝ kaa kǝ nǝ aɗeng.
Abet, nciit kǝ mǝnǝ, ɓǝ gurum mo kun, ɗe mo kǝ lep mo nSizariya mbǝ jì pet an, mo kǝ ɗar mpwoo lu ɗe an ɗi.
Riin mǝ Naan sat nghan nǝ, a seet ashak kǝ mo, baa ashak kǝ mee kyetwo kas. Pak nenseet nɗang Jesu mo peemee, mo seet ashak kǝ an zak, ɓǝ mu dǝm mu ɗel nlu kǝ gwar nǝ.

Yaksǝ gwar nǝ wur sat mmun nǝ, ɗi naa mee ngulep mǝ Naan kǝ ɗar nɗǝǝn lu fin, ɗang ngulep nǝ sat nɗyin nǝnee, <A lep shindǝm nJoppa, kǝ mo pet mee gwar ɗe mo kǝ pet sǝm wur a Simon Pita jì ntul fwaa.>
Wur mbǝ nsatpwoo nghan ɗe nǝn nle kǝ nwun kat ɓam, waa kǝ nenlu fwaa mo jir.
<<Kaaɗe nɗoom leshap, ɓǝ Riin Ɗeɓang sham nkaa mo, nciit kǝ ɗe dǝ wur sham nkaa mun nshee sǝ.
Ɓǝ nǝ le nghan panpwoo mǝ Daa, ɗe gyet wur sat nǝnee, <Joon kǝ cìn baptisma ngurum mo a shi am, ɗangnaan wur mbǝ ncìn baptisma nwun a shi Riin Ɗeɓang.>
Katɗang ɓǝ mbiizuum ɗesǝ, ɗe Naan wur shin mmo, nǝ a ɗemǝndong kǝ ɗewur shin mmun, mbǝɗe mu shinzeen nDaa Jesu Kristi, ɓǝ wen a wii, ɗe an mmak cíi nNaan yii?>>
Kaaɗe mo kǝlǝng pwoo mǝnǝ, ɓǝ mo ɗok tǝtǝk, yaksǝ mo kwoop Naan ɗeɗes. Mo sat nǝ, <<Daa Naan kǝ shínpee nnen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas, mbǝkǝ mo tuwap, kǝ mo kat seen ɗi zak.>>
Nbenseet nDang Jesu Ɗe Mon Antiyok

Nen ɗe dǝ mo rangkáa mbǝ jeel ɗe nǝ kǝ yool, ɗe nǝ le gyet mo tu Stivin, ɓǝ pak mo dǝm wul nyil mFonisha, kǝ Saiprus, kǝ pee nkaam nAntiyok. Baa mo satpwoo Naan nǝ, mmee nen ɗecì mo kas, tǝng a nnen Yahudi mo ɓejee ɗak.
Ɗangɓe pak nen shinzeen nǝ mo, ɗe mo a nen Saiprus mo, kǝ Sairin mo, mo dǝm wul Antiyok, ɓǝ mo kop pwoo Naan nǝ nnen Helene mo zak, kǝzak mo leshap ɗeret ngurum mo nkaa Daa Jesu.
Iiko mǝ Daa nǝ ɗi ashak kǝ mo, ɓǝ gurum mo ɗes mo shinzeen, ɓǝ mo ciir kǝ pǝtuup fur mo pǝ Daa Naan ɗi.
Pwoo nkaa mo nǝ wul nkom mǝ nenseet nɗang Jesu ɗe mo kǝ tong nɗǝǝn Jerusalem, ɓǝ mo lep Barnabas, kǝ nwur dǝm ɗe Antiyok nǝ.
Kaaɗe wur seet wul, ɓǝ wur naa ɗeret ɗe Naan le nkaa mo, ɓǝ wur kat retnyit, ɗang wur leshap mmo jir, mbǝkǝ mmo ɗar ɓalɓal nɗǝǝn shinzeen nNaan azeen-zeen shi pǝtuup fur mo jir.
Barnabas a mee ngwe ɗe ndǝre, kǝzak wur gam kǝ Riin Ɗeɓang, kǝ shinzeen zak. Gurum mo ɗes mo shinzeen nDaa zak.
Aɓwoon mǝnǝ, ɓǝ Barnabas dǝm nTarsus, mbǝ yap Sool.

Kaaɗe wur kat Sool, ɓǝ wur jì kǝ wur nAntiyok. Mbǝ ɓit mǝndong, ɓǝ Barnabas kǝ Sool moo kaat ashak kǝ nen shinzeen nǝ mo, yaksǝ mo kám-kam ngurum mo. Mo shee pet nenseet nɗang Jesu mo a Kristiyan a nɗǝǝn pee nkaam Antiyok.
Nɗǝǝn teer mǝnǝ mo, ɓǝ pak nensatpwoo mǝ Naan mo pwat nJerusalem, ɓǝ mo jì Antiyok.

Memee nɗǝǝn mo, ɗe sǝm wur a Agabus, wur yool ɗar atǝng, ɓǝ wur sat agaak shi iiko ɓal mǝ Riin Ɗeɓang nǝnee, <<Mee neen ɗeɗes nǝ mbǝ taa nkaa yil nǝ jir.>> Mo cìn mǝnǝ a nɗǝǝn ɓit ɗe Klodiyus a mishkoom.
Nenseet nɗang Jesu mo le pǝtuup fur mo, kǝ koo weyi, ɓǝ wur shin mbii ɗewur mak, mbǝkǝ mmo lep ɓam dǝm ɗi nnen shinzeen ɗe mo kǝ tong nɗǝǝn yil nJudiya.
Kaaɗe mo cak zuum fur nǝ mo le ashak, ɓǝ mo lep shindǝm nnen ɗǝnan-nan mǝ nen shinzeen ɗe mo kǝ tong nɗǝǝn yil nJudiya nsar Barnabas kǝ Sool.
